Strategy: Rounded-ratio band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals whose ratio to the item rounds to one score far lower, while other residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit has a residual near the item size while a looser bin avoids that band. It may help by avoiding leftovers sized like the item just placed, but may fail if it pushes items into roomy bins too often.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - 200.0 if round((r - item) / item) == 1 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Rounded-ratio band avoidance: penalize residual with round(rem/item)==1 by 200, exact fit highest.
